ruleset.name: nitpicker-test-honesty
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for test sources.

rule.name: DisabledTest
rule.message: Fix or delete this test instead of disabling it (@Disabled, @Ignore, @Test(enabled = false), assumeTrue(false)). Limit it to an environment with @EnabledOnOs or an assumption on a real condition.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AssertionInControlFlow
rule.message: Assert unconditionally: an assertion in a branch, loop or iterating callback (forEach, map, filter), also in a helper the test calls, does not run when the branch is not taken or the collection is empty. Assert the whole collection at once, use a parameterized test (@ParameterizedTest) for a table of cases, or assertAll(() -> ..., () -> ...). A loop with a literal count (for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++), IntStream.range(0, 3)) and a do-while always run and are fine.
rule.description: An assertion that may not run proves nothing.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $tests := //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = ('Test', 'ParameterizedTest', 'RepeatedTest', 'TestFactory', 'TestTemplate')]], $others := //MethodDeclaration except $tests, $first := $others[@Name = $tests//MethodCall/@MethodName], $second := $others[@Name = $first//MethodCall/@MethodName], $third := $others[@Name = $second//MethodCall/@MethodName], $helpers := $first | $second | $third, $ranges := //MethodCall[(@MethodName = 'range' and (ArgumentList/*[1]/@ValueAsInt) < (ArgumentList/*[2]/@ValueAsInt)) or (@MethodName = 'rangeClosed' and (ArgumentList/*[1]/@ValueAsInt) <= (ArgumentList/*[2]/@ValueAsInt))], $pass := ('map', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'boxed', 'asLongStream', 'asDoubleStream', 'parallel', 'sequential'), $loops := ($tests | $helpers) //(ForStatement[not( (ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) < (InfixExpression[@Operator = '<'][VariableAccess]/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) or (ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) <= (InfixExpression[@Operator = '<='][VariableAccess]/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) or (ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) > (InfixExpression[@Operator = '>'][VariableAccess]/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) or (ForInit/LocalVariableDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt) >= (InfixExpression[@Operator = '>='][VariableAccess]/NumericLiteral/@ValueAsInt))] | ForeachStatement | WhileStatement | LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong', 'mapToDouble', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'takeWhile', 'dropWhile', 'reduce')]] [not((../../*[1] | ../../*[1][@MethodName = $pass]/*[1] | ../../*[1][@MethodName = $pass]/*[1][@MethodName = $pass]/*[1]) intersect $ranges)]), $branches := ($tests | $helpers)//(IfStatement | SwitchStatement | SwitchExpression | ConditionalExpression), $controls := $loops | $branches return $controls[not(ancestor::* intersect $controls)] [.//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, '^(assert.*|andExpect(All)?|verifyNo.*|verifyZero.*|verify(Complete|Error|Timeout)?|should(HaveNo.*)?|expect(Status|Body|Header|Next.*|Complete|Error.*))$')]]

rule.name: TryCatchInTest
rule.message: Use assertThrows(Type.class, () -> call()) to expect an exception, and let unexpected ones fail the test.
rule.description: try/catch in a test hides failures or asserts nothing.

rule.name: TautologicalAssertion
rule.message: This assertion cannot fail. Assert the value the code under test produces.
rule.description: A constant assertion passes whatever the code does.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AlwaysFailingAssertion
rule.message: This assertion always fails. Call fail("reason") if the test must not get here, or assert the value the code produces.
rule.description: assertTrue(false) and assertFalse(true) are a disguised fail().

rule.name: MockedValueType
rule.message: Do not mock or spy a value type (String, number, date, Optional, record or a concrete collection). Construct a real instance. Mocking an interface such as List or Map is fine.
rule.description: A mocked value only tests the mock.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: TestOrderDependence
rule.message: Tests must not depend on order: give each test its own state, remove @Order and @FixMethodOrder, and use @TestMethodOrder only with MethodOrderer.Random.
rule.description: Order-dependent tests fail when run alone or in parallel.

rule.name: DroppedCallbackInTest
rule.message: The callback this call returns never runs. Pass it on or call it: ctx.run(assertMax(123)) or assertMax(123).accept(ctx), not (ctx) -> assertMax(123) or a bare assertMax(123) statement.
rule.description: A statement that builds a functional-interface value and drops it checks nothing.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $types := ('Runnable', 'Callable', 'Supplier', 'Consumer', 'BiConsumer', 'Function', 'BiFunction', 'Predicate', 'BiPredicate', 'UnaryOperator', 'BinaryOperator', 'Executable', 'ThrowingSupplier', 'ThrowingConsumer', 'ContextConsumer', //(ClassDeclaration | AnnotationTypeDeclaration)[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'FunctionalInterface']]/@SimpleName), $names := //MethodDeclaration[ClassType[@SimpleName = $types]]/@Name return (//ExpressionStatement/MethodCall | //LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('run', 'forEach', 'ifPresent', 'ifPresentOrElse', 'execute', 'assertAll', 'assertThrows')]]/MethodCall) [(@MethodName = $names and *[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]) or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Function#andThen(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Function#compose(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.BiFunction#andThen(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Consumer#andThen(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.BiConsumer#andThen(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Predicate#negate()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Predicate#and(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.function.Predicate#or(_*)')]

rule.name: MessageAfterAssertion
rule.message: This AssertJ description or failure message comes after the assertion, so it never applies. Set it before the assertion: assertThat(x).as("...").isTrue() or assertThat(x).withFailMessage("...").isTrue().
rule.description: as, describedAs, withFailMessage and overridingErrorMessage only apply to the assertions that follow them.
